sample_unit: patients (397 unassisted PCP arm; 372 PCP+DeepDR-LLM arm)

links.outcome: Referable DR identification accuracy of PCPs with vs without AI assistance
links.effect: Average PCP accuracy for identifying referable DR was 81.0% unassisted and 92.3% assisted by DeepDR-Transformer.
links.quote: For identifying referable DR, the average PCP's accuracy was 81.0% unassisted and 92.3% assisted by DeepDR-Transformer.

links.outcome: Patient adherence to self-management and DR referral, PCP with vs without DeepDR-LLM
links.effect: Newly diagnosed patients in PCP+DeepDR-LLM arm showed better self-management (P<0.05); patients with referral DR more likely to adhere to referrals (P<0.01).
links.quote: For patients with referral DR, those in the PCP+DeepDR-LLM arm were more likely to adhere to DR referrals (P < 0.01).

screen.reason: Evaluates a newly developed multimodal image and LLM tool (DeepDR-LLM) in a prospective real-world clinical deployment comparing PCP with vs without AI tool assistance, rather than evaluating an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
